your_book:
Thursday was a mixed session for Jaleel's book, with healthcare dragging and tech/financials picking up the slack. The two heaviest weights told opposite stories: Abbott (10.3%) fell 1.52%, adding incremental pressure to a name already flagged for a trimmed EPS outlook, while NVIDIA (9.9%) gained 1.8% on continued AI-hardware sentiment — though export-control risk hasn't gone away. Boston Scientific (8.9%) was the session's sharpest loser, down 2.94%, compounding a position that's already offside 4.2% and carrying an elevated guidance-slash flag (FY26 growth cut to 7–8.5%). That's a holding where price and thesis are visibly pulling apart. On the bright side, AstraZeneca (+1.94%), ADBE (+2.13%), ONON (+2.01%), and SPGI (+4.37%) all had strong days, with SPGI's move particularly notable given its modest weight.

The drift story centers on BSX and RKLB. BSX rates a STRONG BUY with a solid QARP of 78.4, yet it's down 4.2% overall with management guiding flat through Q3 — the fundamental case and the price action are in tension and earnings aren't until late October. Rocket Lab (6.3% weight) is rated AVOID with a QARP of 39.1 and sits 18.6% in the red — it remains the portfolio's clearest misfit for a capital-preservation mandate. LULU has its next catalyst today (Sep 3 flag), so any guidance update deserves immediate scrutiny given five straight negative Americas comp quarters.

ADBE earnings land September 10 — the narrative-versus-numbers disconnect (AI-moat fear, CFO exit) that drove a post-beat selloff last quarter is still live. Watch whether Thursday's +2.13% move holds into that print. The pharma cluster (GILD, NVS, NBIX, VRTX) continues to carry a quiet drug-pricing policy overhang that doesn't show up in daily moves but hasn't been resolved.

attention.headline: Down 2.94% today, -4.2% overall, guidance slashed — thesis under real stress
attention.note: With FY26 growth cut to 7–8.5% and management guiding flat through Q3, the gap between the STRONG BUY verdict and deteriorating fundamentals is widening; the next check-in isn't until Oct 28, so the question of whether to hold or trim needs to be answered before then.

attention.headline: Risk flag next event date is today — guidance update due now
attention.note: The Sep 3 catalyst date on an already-elevated flag (five straight negative Americas comps, tariff margin hit, China stalled) means any new guidance from Lululemon today must be reviewed immediately to determine whether the HOLD-QUAL rating and current weight are still appropriate.

attention.headline: AVOID-rated, lowest QARP in book (39.1), down 18.6% — position rationale unclear
attention.note: At 6.3% weight, Rocket Lab is the portfolio's largest allocation to a name the model explicitly rates AVOID, with a QARP score nearly 30 points below the book's next-lowest conviction name; a capital-preservation mandate demands a documented reason this position exists at this size.

attention.headline: Earnings Sep 10 — AI-narrative risk could override another beat
attention.note: Last quarter ADBE beat and raised yet sold off on AI-disruption fears and CFO exit; with the same narrative overhang intact, Thursday's +2.13% gain could reverse sharply around the print regardless of the actual numbers.
